# Legacy CStar Compatibility Notice

This file is non-authoritative. Read `AGENTS.md` and the parent Corvus Organism
projection. CStar is archived source and evidence, not the active control plane
or workflow router. No CStar registry, Bead, SET, mission, packet, receipt,
